notes: Gold = non-test Rust code only (tests/ directories and *_test.rs excluded), outside the Enterprise Edition files (enterprise_edition modules, BUSL-1.1). Re-check with `kopt bench meilisearch --verify`.

tasks.question: Where is a tenant token (a JWT signed with an API key) verified, including its expiration date, before a search request is accepted?
tasks.search: tenant token jwt verify api key expiration search
tasks.verifiedBy: Read extractors/authentication/mod.rs@v1.54.3: ActionPolicy::authenticate_tenant_token (search/chat actions only) reads the key uid with extract_key_id (insecure decode), regenerates the key with auth.generate_key, decodes the Claims with tenant_token_validation (HS256/384/512, exp not required) and returns ExpiredTenantToken when now > exp.

tasks.question: Where is the search filter syntax parsed so that OR binds weaker than AND, AND weaker than NOT, with a maximum nesting depth?
tasks.search: filter expression parser or and not precedence depth
tasks.verifiedBy: Read crates/filter-parser/src/lib.rs@v1.54.3 (nom grammar): parse_expression = parse_or -> parse_and ('AND' list) -> parse_not ('NOT' prefix) -> parse_primary; each level returns DepthLimitReached past MAX_FILTER_DEPTH.

tasks.question: With the typo tolerance setting `disableOnNumbers`, where is it decided that a word must only be matched exactly?
tasks.verifiedBy: Read disabled_typos_terms.rs@v1.54.3: DisabledTyposTerms { disable_on_numbers } (camelCase serde) is stored in the index main db; is_exact(word) returns true when disable_on_numbers and every char is numeric or ASCII punctuation.

tasks.question: When too many indexes are open at the same time, where does the index scheduler evict the least recently used index and start closing it?
tasks.search: open indexes evict least recently used close index
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v1.54.3: IndexMap::create inserts the opened index in the LruMap `available`; LruMap::insert returns InsertionOutcome::Evicted when the capacity is reached, and create then calls IndexMap::close on the evicted index (prepare_for_closing, moved to `unavailable` with a new generation).

tasks.question: How does the task scheduler decide which enqueued tasks of one index can be processed together in a single batch, and when does it stop adding tasks to the batch?
tasks.search: scheduler enqueued tasks batch together index stop reason
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v1.54.3: create_next_batch_unprioritized collects the enqueued tasks of the index and calls autobatcher::autobatch, which starts a BatchKind from the first task (BatchKind::new) and folds the next ones with BatchKind::accumulate until it returns ControlFlow::Break with a BatchStopReason.

tasks.question: With dynamic search rules (pinning or boosting documents), how are the rules that apply to a search selected (time window, query and filter conditions), and how are pinned documents kept out of the organic results?
tasks.search: dynamic search rules pin documents time query filter conditions
tasks.verifiedBy: Read milli/src/dynamic_search_rules@v1.54.3: resolve_actions calls active_rules_for_query (active rules filtered by apply_time_conditions, apply_query_conditions, apply_filter_conditions), then iterates find_actions over rules sorted by precedence, removing each pinned id from `universe` (so it cannot appear organically and must pass the filter) within the DsrFuel limits.

tasks.question: How does the search apply the ranking rules one after another, splitting the candidate documents into buckets until enough results have been collected?
tasks.search: ranking rules buckets candidates sort results
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v1.54.3: bucket_sort keeps a stack of RankingRule instances, calls next_bucket on the current rule to get a bucket of candidates, descends to the next rule for buckets with more than one document, and adds finished buckets to the results through maybe_add_to_results (distinct handling, offset/limit) until `length` results are collected.
